promoted_properties.statement: New York intraday ordering of volatility/range/activity is strongly persistent across complete years, while absolute amplitude drifts.
promoted_properties.interpretation: Promote relative intraday shape; do not promote a fixed absolute volatility level.

promoted_properties.statement: Weekday ordering of volatility/range/activity is persistent across 2022-2025; calendar-month ordering is not.
promoted_properties.interpretation: Weekday can be researched as context; month is not promoted as stable context.

promoted_properties.statement: Absolute volatility level is temporally nonstationary in this dataset.
promoted_properties.interpretation: Full-sample absolute thresholds must not be treated as timeless asset constants.

promoted_properties.statement: Minute close-to-close directional persistence is approximately balanced with reversal and remains near 0.5 across complete years.
promoted_properties.interpretation: No dominant 1m directional persistence is established; no contrarian edge is inferred.

promoted_properties.statement: Path efficiency is low on average under the registered metric and its distribution level is comparatively stable across complete years.
promoted_properties.interpretation: Promote distribution-level property only; do not infer mean reversion or predictability.

promoted_properties.statement: Active US-session hours combine higher range/tick activity with narrower observed spread, but spread level itself drifts over time.
promoted_properties.interpretation: Promote time-varying execution-cost context; do not treat spread as constant or infer causality.

promoted_properties.statement: Discontinuities/reopen boundaries are material and must remain explicit in all downstream research.
promoted_properties.interpretation: Promote as data/context handling constraint; temporal stability of reopen magnitudes is not qualified.

promoted_properties.statement: Volatility distributions have heavy full-sample tails relative to their medians.
promoted_properties.interpretation: Promote heavy-tail caution, but not invariant tail levels because absolute volatility drifts.

historical_observations_not_stability_pr.statement: AP4 breakout/reentry frequencies and 2m median / 9m p90 reentry delay are historical future-observation findings.
historical_observations_not_stability_pr.reason: AP6 V0.1 deliberately excludes future-label stability qualification.

historical_observations_not_stability_pr.statement: AP3 20/60/20 compression/normal/expansion shares are construction-defined quantiles.
historical_observations_not_stability_pr.reason: They are descriptive state partitions, not discovered natural probabilities or live thresholds.

downstream_research_candidates: New York time-of-day as a relative context axis
weekday as a candidate context axis
spread and tick-density as provider-specific activity/cost context
